name: bb
description: Builder Bundle (bb): the unified skill set for Inspira builders, 15 skills across 6 trilhas (Pensar, Desenhar, Construir, Revisar, Design, Pesquisar/Doc), invoked as /bb:<skill> (e.g. /bb:spec). It never merges: landing on a protected branch stays with the human. Ships a SessionStart operating-context hook.
